planets.name: WASP-17 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Dìwö with a 3.74-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: WASP-17 b was found in 2009 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Dìwö. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2009, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.73548545, pl_radj 1.87, pl_bmassj 0.78

quotes.title: WASP-17b
quotes.card: WASP-17b, officially named Ditsö̀, is an exoplanet in the constellation Scorpius that is orbiting the star WASP-17.
quotes.introduction: Its discovery was announced on 11 August 2009.
